newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Inchrome to raise capital to 5.0 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Inchrome to raise capital to 5.0 bln pesos.

text.p: Philippine mining firm Integrated Chrome Corp said on Monday its stockholders have approved an increase in authorised capital stock to 5.0 billion pesos from 350 million pesos.
Inchrome also told the Philippine Stock Exchange in a statement that the firm will change its primary purpose to a land and property development company.
It will seek the approval of the Securities and Exchange Commission for a change of corporate name to Gregorio S. Araneta Properties Inc.
Inchrome said it will increase the par value of its shares from 30 centavos to 1.00 per share.
